properties.displayName: UAV S4 - Failsafe Threshold Tampering (FS_THR_ENABLE etc. to 0)
properties.description: Failsafe 임계 파라미터(FS_THR_ENABLE/FS_GCS_ENABLE/FS_EKF_ACTION/FS_CRASH_CHECK/FS_LAND_AERR)가 0으로 설정되거나 이전 값 대비 50% 이하로 급감할 때 탐지. UAVConfigAudit_CL의 ParamValueBefore/ParamValueAfter(Double) 비교 기반. MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0838 / EMB3D 경보설정변조
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let fsParams = dynamic(['FS_THR_ENABLE','FS_GCS_ENABLE','FS_EKF_ACTION','FS_CRASH_CHECK','FS_LAND_AERR']);
UAVConfigAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where ParamId in (fsParams)
| extend isDisabling = ParamValueAfter == 0
    or (isnotnull(ParamValueBefore) and ParamValueBefore > 0 and ParamValueAfter < ParamValueBefore * 0.5)
| where isDisabling
| extend TriggerReason = strcat('Failsafe_임계값_비활성화_', ParamId, '_', tostring(ParamValueBefore), '→', tostring(ParamValueAfter))
| extend Severity = 'High'
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, ParamId, ParamValueBefore, ParamValueAfter, Source, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S4 - Failsafe Threshold Tampering (FS_THR_ENABLE etc. to 0) - {{UAVId}}
